purpose: Bounded original-source GPU quantized FFN exploration, not product promotion
reference_source: existing real Qwen layer0 fixture and original BF16 captures; no generated/repeated-row surrogate for real M1024
format: MLX affine uint32 Q4/Q8, FP16 scale/bias, group64; explicitly not GGML Q4_0/Q8_0

followup_after_initial_sg_negatives.hypothesis: Original SG loaders issue global weight reads across output rows; test contiguous K loads, then a 16-byte threadgroup row skew as a separate ablation. No physical bank-counter claim.

control: packed MLX quantized_matmul; separately compare passing candidates against unquantized compiled FP16-source FFN
strong_original_control: Add an original BF16 checkpoint/capture baseline. Read selected tensors in memory with original hashes, restore original [1,M,H] BF16 output, include candidate input/output casts; do not substitute recovered FP16 weights or synthetic activations.
confirmation: layer-0-step-19, new process, fixed candidate, no retuning gates
smoke_controls: random nondivisible M/N, group-aligned K, actual stride2 input, output poison/tail guards
rules: Record and retain every attempted comparison, including failed gates and compile errors.
Same packed-format implementation speed is not original BF16 model speed or quality.
A cached decoded matrix is extra residency and preparation, not zero-cost dequantization.
A failed same-recipe numeric arm receives no speedup ratio.
No original-model speed ratio when its fixed component quality budget fails.
No LoRA, default-route or request-quality promotion from these component experiments.
